method: offline Unicorn runs of the original slot-3 entries over the memory image with synthetic geom blocks, shapes and guarded output buffers; return value and every output byte compared with engine.pose_narrowphase_kind45; executed addresses are recorded and must stay inside the named routines ((4,4)) or the contact-code region, the stack probe and the CRT trig helpers ((4,5), (5,5)); the (4,5) growth allocator 0x193d8f0 must not run

capsule_hull.native: entry, core, 0x18f3710 (distance query) and every callee run natively
supplied_to_model: the 0x30-byte result block of 0x18f3710 at core rbp+0x60, read at its return 0x19dd22f (native execution is not interrupted); its two input points (core rsp+0x40/+0x50) must equal the model axis points
model_reuses: 0x18e3450 side planes through engine.pose_contact_side_planes (float model) on the penetrating face path

hull_hull.native: thunk, core, selector 0x190f700, queries, face emitter 0x18e4060, edge emitter 0x18e3aa0 and all helpers run natively; the model composes the existing engine modules

supplied_state: runtime XYZ mask 0x3336890 = {-1,-1,-1,0} (zero in the image)
TLS: gs:[0x58] slot array, index 0x333c630 = 0, thread epoch 0x7fffffff at +0x4eec, so guarded static initializers are skipped

guarded statics 0x3336a30/0x3336a50/0x3336a70 = 1e-7 x4, the initializer values (before 2026-11-05 only 0x3336a30 was set, so 18f3710 ran its triangle and volume degeneracy tests with zero thresholds)
gs:[0x10] stack limit for the stack probe
limits: Synthetic fixtures: random capsules and authored convex prisms (3..8 sides), not game assets.

Kind-5 fixtures set shape+0x40 to the descriptor vertex array (except (4,5) desc_vertex_split cases, where descriptor +0 is a separate copy scaled by 1.004 or 0.996), shape+0x48 to its count and shape+0xc0 to 0 (no support lookup table); real assets may differ.
Fixture hull edges run counter-clockwise around plane0 (direction parallel to n0 x n1), the orientation 0x18e3640 needs for outward side planes.
0x18f3710 (capsule-hull distance query) is not restated: its native result is supplied.
The penetrating (4,5) face path uses the float model of 0x18e3450, so NaN propagation there is not lane-exact; fixtures are finite.
(4,5) and (5,5) fixtures are finite; NaN/inf lanes are exercised only for (4,4).
MXCSR is the Unicorn default 0x1f80; hardware two-NaN choice is not observed.
